trace.error_message: Rollout halted after us-east: orchestrator error

args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks following the deployment of v2.3.1 (error rate ~18%). Per the platform runbook, the service was rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (us-east rolled back, us-west/eu-west remained on v2.3.1) and a retry completed the rollout. Post-rollback verification: all regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate down to 0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 due to failing health checks

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

**Rollback (checkout-api)**
- Deployment history showed **v2.3.1** (latest deploy) was unhealthy in production, with **v2.3.0** being the most recent healthy release.
- First rollback attempt partially failed: us-east rolled back, but us-west and eu-west remained on v2.3.1 (service still unhealthy, ~18% error rate).
- Retried the rollback — all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) now on **v2.3.0**.
- Post-rollback verification: service is **healthy in all regions**, error rate down to **0.2%**.

**Incident**
- The incident creation call initially timed out, but listing incidents confirmed it was created successfully (the idempotency key prevented a duplicate): **INC-0001**, SEV2, open, documenting the health check failures, the partial-failure and retry of the rollback, and the verified recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.

No further action needed — v2.3.1 will need investigation before the next deploy attempt.
